bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
printf 'CREATOR_DM_RUNTIME_AUDIT_BEGIN\n'
printf 'SOURCE_HEAD=';git rev-parse HEAD
printf 'SOURCE_BRANCH=';git branch --show-current
printf 'RUNNING_CREATOR_CONTAINERS\n'
docker ps --format '{{.Names}}|{{.Status}}' | grep -Ei 'create|videobot|video-bot|postgres' || true
printf 'RELEVANT_DOCKER_NETWORKS\n'
docker network ls --format '{{.Name}}' | grep -Ei 'gserver|tgtumbler' || true
printf 'OWNER_PORTS\n'
for f in /opt/videobot/owner/gateOwner.mjs ./deploy/owner/gateOwner.mjs ./owner/gateOwner.mjs; do if test -f "$f";then printf 'OWNER_BRIDGE_EXISTS=%s\n' "$f";fi;done
printf 'CREATOR_MIGRATION_STATUS\n'
if test -d deploy/secrets; then echo PRIVATE_SECRETS_DIR=YES; else echo PRIVATE_SECRETS_DIR=NO;fi
python3 -B - <<'PY'
import json,re,stat,urllib.request,urllib.error
from pathlib import Path
p=Path.cwd()
sources=[p/'deploy'/'secrets',p/'deploy',Path.home()/'.config'/'create-videobot']
tokens=set()
for d in sources:
 if not d.is_dir():continue
 for f in d.iterdir():
  try:
   if f.is_symlink() or not f.is_file():continue
   st=f.stat()
   if st.st_mode & 0o022 or not 35<=st.st_size<=8192:continue
   low=f.name.lower()
   if any(x in low for x in ('userbot','session','phone','oauth','backup')):continue
   if not any(x in low for x in ('bot','token','secret','.env')):continue
   data=f.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
   if re.fullmatch(r'\d{7,15}:[A-Za-z0-9_-]{30,100}',data.strip()):tokens.add(data.strip())
   else:
    for line in data.splitlines():
     if '=' not in line or line.lstrip().startswith('#'):continue
     k,v=line.split('=',1)
     if 'TOKEN' in k.upper() and any(x in k.upper() for x in ('CREATE','VIDEO','VDO','TELEGRAM')):
      v=v.strip().strip('"').strip("'")
      if re.fullmatch(r'\d{7,15}:[A-Za-z0-9_-]{30,100}',v):tokens.add(v)
  except (OSError,UnicodeError):pass
def api(token,method):
 req=urllib.request.Request(f'https://api.telegram.org/bot{token}/{method}',data=b'{}',headers={'Content-Type':'application/json'},method='POST')
 with urllib.request.urlopen(req,timeout=12) as r:return json.load(r)
for tok in tokens:
 try:
  me=api(tok,'getMe')
  if not me.get('ok') or str(me['result'].get('username','')).lower()!='createvdobot':continue
  print('CREATOR_IDENTITY=VERIFIED')
  wh=api(tok,'getWebhookInfo')['result']
  print('CREATOR_WEBHOOK_REGISTERED='+('YES' if wh.get('url') else 'NO'))
  print('CREATOR_PENDING_UPDATES='+str(wh.get('pending_update_count','UNKNOWN')))
  print('CREATOR_WEBHOOK_LAST_ERROR='+('YES' if wh.get('last_error_message') else 'NO'))
  print('CREATOR_WEBHOOK_ALLOWED_UPDATES='+','.join(wh.get('allowed_updates') or []))
  break
 except Exception:continue
else:print('CREATOR_IDENTITY=NOT_VERIFIED')
PY
printf 'CREATOR_DM_RUNTIME_AUDIT_END\n'
